title: Wonderful

author: Tetsuya_O

title: Amazing walking tour of Carmona
text: We had a brilliant morning with Enrique on a walking tour introducing us to Carmona. Enrique's deep knowledge and love of his home town, its history, architecture and archeology was inspiring. I would absolutley recommend Enrique to anyone wanting to learn more about this incredible town and Andalucia in general.
author: mariamW4302PE

title: Fabulous hidden gem!
text: Fabulous tour with Enrique! We all enjoyed learning the history of Carmona. As well as what is happening today. We had a wonderful day because there were not many tourists…the city of Carmona is charming. We would love to stay in Carmona the next time we’re in Spain to fully immerse and enjoy this hidden gem. Thank you Enrique!!
author: Maria_R

title: Fantastic fun walking tour
text: Terrific walking tour with knowledgeable, local guide, Enrique who added history and insights into the entire morning
author: Paul_H

title: We had the right and lucky to contact Vandalia Tours
text:
